headline.purpose: Settings-page task headings and the strongest full-page section introductions.

title.purpose: Filing-slip, success, and compact state headings.

body.purpose: Instructions, editable values, supporting copy, and action labels.

label.purpose: Condensed uppercase field labels, record numbers, descriptors, and stamps.

shadows.name: host-page-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates the injected capture panel from arbitrary employer-page content.

shadows.name: sticky-paper-fade
shadows.purpose: Protects the popup destination and filing action over scrolling form content.

motion.name: panel-arrival
motion.purpose: Reveals the injected filing slip upward from the host-page edge.

motion.name: page-scan
motion.purpose: Moves the short ledger-green scan line while the popup reads a posting.

motion.name: filing-spinner
motion.purpose: Rotates the filing action icon in discrete quarter-turns during a write.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Collapses animation and transition duration when reduced motion is requested; the injected panel arrival is removed entirely.

components.name: Primary Filing Button
components.description: The commit action for connecting, preparing, or filing a record.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:42px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid var(--forest); border-radius:5px; background:var(--forest); color:var(--surface); font:700 14px/1.45 var(--sans); letter-spacing:0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--forest-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus) 45%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:var(--forest-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor:wait; opacity:.62; }

components.name: Secondary Ledger Button
components.description: A bordered alternative for retries, opening the sheet, and other non-commit actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height:42px; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:9px; padding:0 15px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:5px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font:700 14px/1.45 var(--sans); letter-spacing:0; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:#edf1ee; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus) 45%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active { background:#e9eeea; }

components.name: Settings Icon Button
components.description: A quiet square utility control used at the edge of the masthead.
components.css: .ds-icon-button { width:36px; height:36px; display:inline-grid; place-items:center; border:0; border-radius:4px; background:transparent; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; } .ds-icon-button svg { width:18px; height:18px; fill:none; stroke:currentColor; stroke-width:1.8; stroke-linecap:round; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-icon-button:hover { background:#e9eeea; color:var(--ink); } .ds-icon-button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus) 45%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-icon-button:active { background:#dce9e2; }

components.name: Record Text Field
components.description: An editable filing value with a narrow uppercase record label.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Organization<input class="ds-input" value="Royal Bank of Canada"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:5px; color:var(--muted); font:700 11px/1.2 var(--record); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:39px; border:1px solid var(--line); border-radius:4px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); padding:9px 10px; font:400 14px/1.45 var(--sans); text-transform:none; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:var(--line-strong); } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--focus); outline:2px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus) 20%,transparent); }

components.name: Draft Status Stamp
components.description: A rare, noninteractive annotation that marks the record as provisional.
components.css: .ds-status-stamp { display:inline-block; padding:5px 7px 4px; border:1px solid var(--signal); border-radius:3px; color:var(--signal); background:transparent; font:800 10px/1 var(--record); letter-spacing:0; text-transform:uppercase; transform:rotate(-2deg); }

components.name: Semantic Notice
components.description: A compact text-first band for neutral progress, success, or actionable failure messages.
components.html: Paste a complete Google Sheets link.
components.css: .ds-notice { margin:0; padding:10px 11px; border-radius:4px; background:#e9eeea; color:#344139; font:400 12px/1.45 var(--sans); letter-spacing:0; } .ds-notice-error { background:var(--signal-soft); color:#7a2818; } .ds-notice-success { background:var(--mint); color:#174a37; }

components.name: Ledger Masthead
components.description: The dark orientation band with the paper mark, product name, surface descriptor, and optional count.

components.css: .ds-masthead { min-height:70px; display:grid; grid-template-columns:32px 1fr auto; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:12px 14px; background:var(--forest); color:var(--surface); } .ds-brand-mark { width:28px; height:34px; padding:7px 6px; display:grid; align-content:center; gap:4px; background:var(--surface); border-radius:3px; } .ds-brand-mark span { height:2px; background:var(--forest); } .ds-brand-mark span:last-child { width:65%; } .ds-brand-copy { display:grid; gap:2px; } .ds-brand-copy strong { font:750 17px/1.2 var(--sans); letter-spacing:0; } .ds-brand-copy small { color:#cde0d5; font:700 10px/1.2 var(--record); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-step-mark { border:1px solid #7ca18f; border-radius:3px; padding:6px 8px; color:#e3eee8; font:700 11px/1 var(--record); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0; }

components.name: Application Record Header
components.description: The filing-slip heading that pairs record identity and review instruction with a stamped state.
components.css: .ds-record-heading { display:flex; align-items:flex-start; justify-content:space-between; gap:16px; color:var(--ink); } .ds-record-heading h2 { margin:3px 0 0; font:700 20px/1.18 var(--sans); letter-spacing:0; } .ds-record-number { color:var(--muted); font:800 10px/1 var(--record); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0; } .ds-record-stamp { padding:5px 7px 4px; border:1px solid var(--signal); border-radius:3px; color:var(--signal); font:800 10px/1 var(--record); text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:0; transform:rotate(-2deg); }

components.name: Worksheet Ledger Row
components.description: A ruled, indexed choice row for scanning worksheet destinations without card chrome.
components.css: .ds-ledger-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items:center; gap:12px; min-height:58px; border-top:1px solid var(--line); border-bottom:1px solid var(--line); color:var(--ink); font:400 14px/1.45 var(--sans); letter-spacing:0; } .ds-ledger-index { color:var(--muted); font:700 11px/1 var(--record); } .ds-ledger-row strong { overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-ledger-row button { min-height:34px; padding:0 12px; border:1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius:5px; background:var(--surface); color:var(--ink); font:700 14px/1.45 var(--sans); cursor:pointer; } .ds-ledger-row button:hover { background:#edf1ee; } .ds-ledger-row button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus) 45%,transparent); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-ledger-row button:active { background:#e9eeea; }

narrative.overview:
Job Sheet turns a live job posting into a compact, inspectable paper record. Its visual world is administrative without feeling bureaucratic: paper-white surfaces, ledger-green chrome, fine horizontal rules, and narrow record labels make each field feel ready to verify and file.

The system is quiet, dense, and work-focused. Hierarchy comes from alignment, rules, type roles, and small shifts in tone rather than decorative containers. A restrained vermilion stamp marks provisional or exceptional states, while the workflow remains legible as a three-part sequence: inspect, correct, file.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-white surfaces with compact filing-ledger density.
Ledger green for mastheads, primary actions, and trusted destinations.
Fine rules and condensed uppercase labels for record structure.
Vermilion status-stamp accents for draft and error states.
Explicit review, destination, loading, success, and recovery states.

rules.name: The One Stamp Rule
rules.body: Status Vermilion is reserved for the small stamp and error family; it does not compete with Ledger Forest for primary action.

rules.name: The Paper-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: Build hierarchy with Fresh Sheet, Archive Paper, Filing Ink, and rules before introducing another color.

rules.name: The Record Label Rule
rules.body: Use condensed uppercase type only for metadata and field structure; keep values, instructions, and actions in the body face and natural case.

rules.name: The Zero Tracking Rule
rules.body: Letter spacing remains zero even in uppercase labels; hierarchy comes from width, weight, case, and placement.

rules.name: The Host-Layer Rule
rules.body: Apply substantial elevation only when Job Sheet must sit above a host website; native extension surfaces remain flat and ruled.

dos: Do make the current record, its status, its destination, and its final filing action visible in one clear reading order.
Do use fine one-pixel rules, compact spacing, and aligned labels to create structure before adding containers.
Do preserve explicit hover, focus, loading, success, error, disabled, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do collapse paired fields and side-by-side actions when the available width no longer supports comfortable labels and values.
Do keep Vermilion status cues paired with words such as DRAFT or an actionable error message.
donts: Don't turn settings sections or individual fields into rounded card stacks.
Don't use Status Vermilion as a competing primary action color or as ambient decoration.
Don't add large display typography, excessive whitespace, gradients, or illustrative ornament to operational surfaces.
Don't apply floating-panel shadows to popup or settings content that already owns its page surface.
Don't use condensed uppercase type for editable values, instructions, or long-form copy.
